about.title: Ideas need people.
about.introduction: We’re ShowMakers, a marketing agency with creative and execution capabilities across content, digital and live experiences.
about.philosophyTitle: Understand the brand. Make the work matter.
about.philosophyText: Our marketing ideas begin with brand goals and audience behaviour. We bring creative thinking and practical execution together, with internal review to maintain consistency.
about.approachText: Our creative team leads strategy, design, shooting, editing and brand storytelling. AI supports selected research, ideation, scripting, visual direction and content planning. Human judgment and internal review guide the final delivery.

steps.title: Think
steps.text: Understand the business, brand goals and audience before shaping the marketing direction.

steps.title: Create
steps.text: Develop concepts, content and visual direction with the creative team.

steps.title: Execute
steps.text: Turn ideas into media, digital assets and physical brand experiences.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Review the work internally for quality, accuracy and brand consistency.
